name: Reluctant Archon
source:
People don't see the world as it is, they pry to deities hoping for a better life. But don't realize that the same deity is sleeping with their neighbor's wife or having a drink in the bar across the street. Others like to study the creatures of mythology, not knowing they're probably sitting beside one on the bus home. You play the youngest member of the Ashall Family, a family with a long bloodline of Sorcerers, and Spell-weavers. Always kept locked away from the outside world it was made clear your father had a plan for you, how/who/what you'd be, however the rebellious little shit you were never really did what he wanted. And after an event that left hostility between you and your father, you left it all and stepped into that world of deities, humans, and myths hiding in plain sight.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Kyois]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
人们看不到世界的本来面目，他们祈求神明希望过上更好的生活。但不要意识到同一个神正在与邻居的妻子睡觉或在街对面的酒吧喝酒。其他人则喜欢研究神话中的生物，却不知道它们可能就坐在回家的公交车上的旁边。你扮演阿歇尔家族最年轻的成员，这个家族拥有悠久的巫师和法术编织者血统。总是与外界隔绝，很明显你的父亲对你有一个计划，你会成为怎样的人、成为什么样的人，但你这个叛逆的小混蛋从来没有真正按照他的意愿去做。在一次导致你和父亲之间产生敌意的事件之后，你抛开了一切，走进了那个神、人类和神话隐藏在眼前的世界。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Kyois]Patreon[/url]]
